$comment: PROPOSED format (SCH-006): not a frozen standard. It may change until stabilized by tests and an ADR. The Rust parser in crates/glint-schema (src/profile.rs) is authoritative where this schema and the parser disagree; tests keep their field sets aligned. Unknown fields are rejected everywhere except inside monitor placement objects, whose shape the surface/layout engine owns. A wallpaper path is a private user file: local-only and stripped on export, as are monitor keys other than primary and secondary.
title: Glint profile (profile.json) v1
description: The user's active composition: base theme, per-surface override themes, wallpaper, per-monitor placement overrides and semantic token overrides. Exact releases (origin and digest) are pinned by the matching profile.lock.

$schema.description: Editor hint only; Glint never dereferences it.

id.description: Local profile id: dot-separated lowercase segments, e.g. default, work-setup or profile.custom-mix.

baseTheme.description: Base theme. When absent only the built-in default safe theme applies.

surfaces.description: Surface overrides: each named surface is provided by another theme; other surfaces are unaffected.

wallpaper.description: Exactly one of path (a private user file relative to the profile directory; local-only, stripped on export) or asset (a named asset of the base theme).

monitors.description: Per-monitor placement overrides: monitor key, then surface ID, then a placement object whose shape the surface/layout engine owns. primary and secondary are portable roles; other keys are machine-specific and local-only.

exactVersion.description: Exact semantic version (SemVer 2.0), not a range.

relativePath.description: Relative, /-separated path inside the package: no leading /, no empty, . or .. segments, no backslash or colon, no Windows-reserved characters or device names, no segment ending in . or space.
